scope: Small finite CLI clients; Rust frontend versus Rust frontend plus dual verification

method.included: process launch, source loading/checking, transport, JSON output; emit-ir also writes and syncs a fresh file
method.excluded: binary builds, warmups, output equality assertions, untimed invocation counter
method.cache: warm OS caches; fresh CLI/kernel processes; no persistent verifier
method.controls: no concurrent jobs launched by the harness; no CPU pinning or control over external system load
